stem.en: Using the same numbers (m₁ = 4 kg, m₂ = 2 kg, g = 9.8 N/kg), find the tension in the string in newtons, to 2 decimal places.

explanation.en: T = m₁a = 4 × 3.27 ≈ 13.07 N. Checking with the hanging block: T = m₂(g − a) = 2 × (9.8 − 3.27) = 2 × 6.53 = 13.07 N — matches.

hints.en: You already found a in the last question. The table block's own equation was T = m₁a.
T = m₁ × a — plug in the acceleration you just found.
